intent: 复古双色调印刷海报感：抽象几何底图，画面转为深蓝与米白双色，带浮雕纹理线条

iterations.critique: Uniform flat slate frame at both t1 and t4 — no geometry, no duotone, no relief. Root cause: Fractal Type 2 (sparse/threshold) at Contrast 260 collapses to a near-uniform field; the mirror-tile of nothing is nothing, and Emboss over a featureless base outputs its neutral grey which the 45% blend mixes into the tint = the observed slate. The stack's structure is fine; the BASE generator degenerated.

Relief works now — embossed marble-vein lines with clear dimensionality on a cream field, reads as printed paper texture. But the duotone criterion is half-absent: type-13's field is mostly bright, so nearly everything maps to cream; deep blue exists only in thin vein shadows. Poster needs both tones as masses, not one tone plus outlines.

Closest of the three iters: blue-dominant field with dense cream embossed veinwork, strong relief, evolving structure. Still short of the ask on two counts: Emboss's grey blend desaturates the deep blue into slate (the 'strict duotone' punch is gone), and the marble structure reads organic-wallpaper rather than 印刷海报 graphic. Max-iters reached — recording as fail. Planner lesson: only Fractal Type 1's semantics are vision-enriched; types 2/13 were reasoned from one-line labels, and the Emboss-desaturation interaction wasn't anticipated.
